findings.section: FR-002 — Snapshot fidelity; SC-001 — Complete bounded package
findings.note: The baseline is not pinned to a named captured snapshot or required per-file identity; “sufficiently” and later drift disclosure leave the comparison baseline ambiguous. Specify the snapshot identifier and reproducible inventory/content evidence needed before assembly so the 100%/zero-difference result is independently verifiable.

findings.section: Edge Cases; FR-001 — Bounded independent deliverable
findings.note: Assembly preflights the destination but does not define behavior if a filesystem error or interruption occurs after copying starts. State whether a partial package remains and the safe recovery/retry rule, without implying cleanup of user data.
